prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent exploded-view product sprite for a scroll-driven food website.
Use the referenced Belev pastila photo only for the actual food texture and colors. Create ONE vertically exploded rectangular piece of real Belev apple pastila consisting of EXACTLY FIVE separate floating components, all aligned on the same vertical center axis:
1 top: a thick golden tan porous apple souffle slab, subtly powdered top
2 next: a thin dark burgundy berry-pastila slab
3 middle: a thick golden tan porous apple souffle slab
4 next: a thin dark burgundy berry-pastila slab
5 bottom: a thick golden tan porous apple souffle slab.
All five slabs have identical rectangular footprints and the SAME camera angle, looking slightly down from the front-right, like an architectural exploded product view. Each layer is fully visible and completely separated from all other layers by a large clear transparent gap. No pieces touch or overlap. The thin berry layers are made of the same matte porous fruit material, not wet jelly. Natural irregular edges, fine airy texture, commercial photorealism, restrained warm side light.
Portrait 2:3 canvas. Slabs arranged down the page, not diagonally. Keep 8 percent margins around all objects. No cast shadow on any background, only subtle self-shadow on the food. True transparent alpha background, no table, no fruit, no leaves, no plate, no text, no decorative elements.
Important: five isolated pieces so a developer can animate each layer separately from this image. No connected crumbs between pieces.
